A '''copper mattock''' is the [[Copper equipment|copper]] [[mattock]], a shovel and hoe in one tool. It is crafted from [[copper ingot]]s and sticks, and is the earliest mattock a player can make.

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===
The copper mattock breaks both shovel and hoe blocks at speed 5, one slower than the [[copper shovel]] or [[copper hoe]] in exchange for doing both jobs. It has 350 durability. It collects snowballs from snow like a shovel.

Hoes in Matcha Flavoured also break wool, carpets, glow lichen and [[Phosphor lamps|phosphor lamps]] quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/hoe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Hp|1}} damage at an attack speed of 2.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[copper ingot]]s. As with all equipment in the pack, the repair cost never grows, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting and smithing ===
{{Uses}}

In a [[blast furnace]], it melts down into a copper ingot. Because it uses the copper hoe's item ID, it can also stand in for a copper hoe in the [[Shakudo equipment|shakudo]] and [[Hepatizon equipment|hepatizon]] smithing recipes.
